relations.subject: Melvyn C. Goldstein
relations.evidence: He pursued his research in anthropology at the University of Washington and was awarded a PhD in 1968.

relations.subject: Melvyn C. Goldstein
relations.evidence: In 1968, he joined the faculty of the Department of Anthropology at Case Western Reserve University as an assistant professor. He became an associate professor in 1974

relations.subject: Melvyn C. Goldstein
relations.evidence: He became an associate professor in 1974 and full Professor in 1978.

relations.subject: Melvyn C. Goldstein
relations.evidence: and full Professor in 1978. From 1975 to 2002 he was the Chairman of the Department of Anthropology.

relations.subject: Melvyn C. Goldstein
relations.evidence: Between 1987 and 1991 he was the Director of the Center for Research on Tibet, and is still the co-director.

relations.subject: Melvyn C. Goldstein
relations.evidence: Goldstein and Cynthia Beall were the first Western anthropologists to conduct extensive field research in Tibet when they stayed for 16 months between June 1986 and June 1988.
